sources.title: Parenting Objects — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: sections on Object Parent, Bone Parent, Parent Inverse, Keep Transform, non-uniform scale
supports: Bone parent vs object parent; Parent Inverse; Keep Transform; non-uniform scale can cause shear
limits: Blender behavior only; engine import behavior not covered

sources.title: Armature Deform Parent — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full section on Empty Groups, Automatic Weights, Envelope Weights
supports: Armature Deform Parent creates an Armature modifier and sets the armature as parent; automatic weights can be wrong on complex parts
limits: Blender-specific; does not define a universal weight/bone budget

sources.title: Armature Modifier — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full modifier options and Bind to sections
supports: Vertex groups of the same name drive weights; weights control per-bone influence; rigid 1.0 weight is valid

sources.title: Object Origin — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full origin section including Set Origin types
supports: Object origin determines location/rotation/scale; Origin to 3D Cursor can place pivot at hinge/slide origin
limits: Does not prescribe where a prop pivot should be

sources.title: Bone Relations — Blender 5.2 LTS Manual
sources.author: Blender Foundation / Blender Manual contributors
sources.read_scope: full Relations section including Local Location and Inherit Rotation/Scale
supports: Per-bone Local Location, Inherit Rotation and Inherit Scale change how child bones consume parent transforms; connected bones cannot be translated independently
limits: Blender behavior only; engine retarget/import may differ

sources.title: Hinge Joint component reference — Unity 6000.0
sources.author: Unity Technologies
supports: Anchor/Axis local; Connected Body and hinge chains; nested cat flap example; Spring/Motor mutually exclusive; limits/contact distance/break force/mass scale
limits: Component reference, not a project test; Unity-specific; no run

sources.title: Rigidbody component reference — Unity 6000.0
sources.author: Unity Technologies
supports: Is Kinematic means the physics system cannot move/rotate the body; only Transform moves it; angular damping and constraints exist

sources.title: Constraints User Guide — Unreal Engine
sources.author: Epic Games
supports: Physics Constraint connects two actors/components; angular swing limits; skeletal mesh constraint bone is a Physics Asset body; component name targeting
limits: UE-specific; no UE run; project setup not covered

sources.title: Physics Constraint Reference — Unreal Engine 4.27
sources.author: Epic Games
supports: Linear Free/Limited/Locked; limit distance; soft constraint; linear/angular break; projection; parent dominates
limits: UE 4.27 reference; property names/behavior may differ in target version; mechanism vocabulary only

sources.title: Physics Damping in Unreal Engine
sources.author: Epic Games
supports: Angular damping; constraint limit stiffness/damping; values require scene-specific experimentation
limits: UE-specific; no universal values; no run

sources.title: AnimatableBody3D — Godot 4.7
sources.author: Godot Engine documentation contributors
supports: Kinematic body manually moved; estimates velocity and affects other bodies; useful for moving platforms/doors; sync_to_physics for AnimationPlayer; do not mix with move_and_collide
limits: Class reference, not a complete elevator/passenger tutorial; no run

sources.title: HingeJoint3D — Godot 4.7
sources.author: Godot Engine documentation contributors
supports: Hinge around an axis; StaticBody door hinge + RigidBody example; angular limits lower/upper; motor enable/target velocity/max impulse

sources.title: Rigging and animating a door, from Blender to Unreal Engine
sources.author: itandfeel (maebara)
supports: Door pivot at origin; Root/Controller bones; Roll 0; bone parent; Copy Rotation local; Limit Rotation 0-90 local; keyframes; FBX bake and no leaf bones; UE import
limits: Single door; no collision/state/network; dimensions/settings not universal; not run

sources.title: Rigging up elevator or sliding doors with an armature (bones)
sources.author: helloserve
sources.read_scope: search snippet only; full page rate-limited
supports: Two bones for double sliding doors; decouple second bone; bone-parent each door; do not use automatic weights; keyframe 0/100
limits: Snippet only; undated; no collision/state/elevator passenger/export; not run

sources.title: Make Interactive Doors and Switches in Blender for Godot
sources.author: Folded Paper Engine
sources.read_scope: search snippet only; full page rate-limited
supports: Animate prop first; correct hinge/slide origin; autoplay off; semantic event; no stacked openings; separate open/close; trigger away from moving geometry; test with second participant
limits: Snippet only; vendor guide; not official; not run
